name: jade_automata
theme: an ancient jade temple whose carvings are mathematics — gold cell-glyphs in a stone panel become a foam universe, and the fall home lands back on the temple terrace

registers.name: temple_terrace
registers.palette: celadon green and pale stone grey
registers.scene: a wide jade temple terrace on a misty mountainside seen from above at the head of the stone stairs, broad flagstones and a low carved balustrade, cloud lying below the parapet, dark pine crowns on the slope beyond, empty, no one present, a carved jade wall panel standing across the courtyard
registers.target: a tall carved jade wall panel, deep celadon stone cut in relief, its border grooves inlaid with vermilion
registers.loop_target: the wide jade temple terrace on the misty mountainside, broad flagstones and a low carved balustrade, cloud lying below the parapet

registers.name: jade_panel
registers.palette: deep green stone and vermilion inlay
registers.scene: a carved jade wall panel standing on the temple terrace, deep celadon stone cut in relief with coiled cloud scrolls and a heavy ring border, vermilion inlay deep in the grooves, broad flagstones at its base, a band of small etched squares along its lower edge
registers.target: a small etched square, five gold cells inlaid in a stepped arrangement

registers.name: glyph_grid
registers.scene: a grid of etched glyph squares ruled across a celadon stone wall, each square holding five square gold cells set in a stepped arrangement, hairline chisel lines between them, the grid running on to a carved border beyond
registers.target: a smooth patch of bare jade, pale celadon stone with faint mottling

registers.name: jade_grain
registers.palette: deep green and rust red in warm pale stone
registers.scene: the mineral grain of jade, deep green mottled spots and winding stripes threaded through warm pale celadon, rust-red flecks scattered through the pattern

registers.name: voronoi_foam
registers.scene: a foam universe of glowing cell walls, thin luminous pale-green sheets bounding enormous black voids, the whole dark sky partitioned into bright-edged chambers
registers.target: a bright white-green junction, a dense core of light

registers.name: filament_web
registers.scene: a branching web of galaxy filaments across the dark, long strands of massed starlight with fine hair-thin offshoots, swollen bright nodes where the strands cross, vermilion sparks along the branches
registers.target: a glowing star cluster, a packed ball of pale green stars

registers.name: star_swarm
registers.scene: a globular swarm of pale green stars packed dense toward a blazing center, thousands of sharp points thinning to the dark at its rim
registers.target: a red-orange star, a hot vermilion point with a thin dust ring around it

registers.name: ember_star
registers.scene: a red-orange star set against the black, a shell of fire with tall prominences standing off its limb, a thin vermilion dust ring wide around it
registers.target: a small celadon-green planet, a pale green disc laced with dark red channels

registers.name: green_planet
registers.scene: a celadon-green planet hanging in the black, its curved limb bright against the dark, pale cloud bands drawn over broad green continents, vermilion river deltas branching across the lowlands
registers.target: a range of green mountains, ridge after ridge

registers.name: mist_mountains
registers.scene: green mountain ridges seen from high above, terraced slopes stepping down into narrow red-earth gorges, cloud caught in the valleys, dark pine crowns along the shoulders, a small stone terrace set on one high shoulder

music_theme: an ancient stone temple in mountain mist, meditative and vast, low bells and breathing strings over a slow pulse, one bright swell landing on the stone-to-cosmos morph
